definition: Multichannel Speaking Automaton (MUSA) was an early prototype of Speech Synthesis machine started in 1975..
details: Multichannel Speaking Automaton (MUSA) was an early prototype of Speech Synthesis machine started in 1975.

explainer.lead: The Multichannel Speaking Automaton (MUSA) was an early prototype of a speech synthesis machine started in 1975. It marks an early step in the history of speech synthesis.

tiers.eli5: A very early machine built in 1975 that tried to talk, long before today's voice assistants.
tiers.practitioner: It is of historical rather than practical interest, as an early speech synthesis prototype begun in 1975.
tiers.paperLevel: MUSA was an early prototype of a speech synthesis machine, started in 1975.

explainer.example: A speech synthesis prototype begun in 1975, predating modern voice assistants by decades.
